text: Thank you for the measurements; the normal readings help rule out obvious metabolic causes. text: My main symptom is Respiratory distress. I also have Grunting, Intercoastal and subcostal retractions, Peripheral cyanosis.

speaker: Doctor
text:

speaker: Doctor
text:
The arterial blood gas shows respiratory acidosis (pH 7.30, elevated PaCO2) and the chest X-ray reveals a ground-glass appearance, which is classic for hyaline membrane disease. Given the baby's prematurity at 33 weeks, this confirms a diagnosis of Respiratory Distress Syndrome.

DIAGNOSIS READY: Respiratory Distress Syndrome (Hyaline Membrane Disease)
